rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial adjective for feeling annoyed or irritated.

example.english: I was really bothered after waiting for an hour.
example.traditional: 我等咗成個鐘，真係好忟。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dang2 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 zan1 hai6 hou2 man4

rows.note: Use this for not minding something or not being concerned about it.

example.english: I’m not bothered if you sit next to me.
example.jyutping: nei5 co5 ngo5 gaak3 lei4 ngo5 m4 gaai3 ji3

rows.note: Use this when the speaker stresses emotional indifference or that something does not matter to them.

example.english: I’m not bothered by what other people say.
example.jyutping: jan4 dei6 dim2 gong2 ngo5 dou1 m4 zoi6 fu1
